parent_objective: audit why temporal/exact-safe projections still fail first replay
blocked_by: M1031 finds 14 temporal/exact-safe projection candidates but 0 pass both M267/M264 and M183/M170 first replay
invalidates: routing M1031 directly to full public gate
running longer PPO from M1026 before first-replay failure is audited

public_gates: M1032 must not use private holdout
M1032 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M1032 must classify whether the M1031 replay failure is M183 row16 normal-margin cliff, broader normal-branch regression, or wrong-history sensitivity loss
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat M267/M264 pass as full first-replay pass
do not ignore M183/M170 row16 normal failure
do not promote any projection candidate

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo: first-replay proof failure after temporal-safe projection
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: separates M1031 first-replay failure into row-level normal-margin cliff versus wrong-history sensitivity loss and chooses the next repair route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit/design only; no checkpoint promotion, no private holdout, no PPO continuation claim
stop_condition: stop if M183/M170 row-level failure cannot be localized from existing replay artifacts
stop if the next route would require relaxing M997 temporal thresholds
stop if the next route would change actor inputs
fallback_plan: if the failure is a single low-slack normal-margin cliff, design active-set terminal-margin retention
if the failure is broad normal-branch regression, design direct M997 plus M183 retention integration
if wrong-history sensitivity is lost, route to rejected-branch objective coverage audit
if low-alpha interpolation is the only remaining uncertainty, design a bounded finer-alpha probe
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1031 projection recovers temporal exact and M267/M264 but fails M183/M170 first replay

hypothesis: M1031's remaining proof washout is caused by an M183/M170 normal-branch terminal-margin cliff, especially row16, rather than loss of wrong-history sensitivity.
success_criteria: M1031 first replay failures are summarized by surface, row, branch, and margin
the next repair route is selected with no PPO, no promotion, and no actor-input change
M183/M170 row16 is either admitted as a hard active-set constraint or ruled out with evidence
failure_criteria: audit cannot localize the M1031 failure
audit recommends longer PPO before repair/gate correction
audit ignores the M183/M170 first replay failure
decision_rule: M1032 should admit implementation only after it identifies whether M183/M170 failure is a normal-margin active-set problem, a broad regression, or a rejected-history proof loss.
